⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

KEEPER OF FATE is the first book in an enthralling new romantasy series by USA Today bestseller Morgan Rice, whose books have over 10,000 five-star ratings.

A millennium ago, an ancient library housing all of the world’s magic was scattered into a thousand hidden repositories to keep a great evil from seizing it, and a prophecy was born: only the Chosen One would find them.

On his 18th birthday, street smart orphan Xander Ashwood finds a doorway he’s never seen before. Inside, he learns that he is not who he thinks is.

As Xander quests after the repositories, he soon learns he’s not the only one.

Xander joins forces with the charming smuggler Rosalind, catching the attention of the noble daughter Alessia of House Veyr.

As Xander pursues magic, prophecy, and new romance, one thing remains unclear: is he the Chosen One? Or is it the villain destined to rise against him?

Magic and destiny collide with heart-pounding action and spellbinding romance in this romantasy series that will captivate your heart and imagination.

Future books in the series are available!
